answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by tying franchise to a delayed, slashed bond rather than to account count. Each new identity lodges a non-transferable stake in a kernel contract and only after peers countersign a trail of original epoch work does that stake mature into full vote and grade weight. A public atlas of those trails makes clone farms obvious: they reuse the same prose and funding path. Recasting a fake cluster is like recarving basalt—the material cost rises with every extra identity, and coordinated spam burns the bond.
